meta.name: make-product-photos
meta.description: Use when the marketer says: studio photos of my product without a shoot, product photos for my store page, packshots on white, lifestyle or on-model shots, photos for the new colourway, fresh product imagery for ads, photos for our launch page, our packaging changed — redo the photos, I have no photographer. Delivers store-ready product photos generated from the brand's real product photos: a shot list built from the page slots (hero, alt angle, scale, detail, in use, lifestyle, on-model), only real photos of this product as references, matched to the brand's photography, every shot checked against the real product for shape, parts, logo, text, colour, finish, scale and honest representation, with a keep / maybe / reject verdict and a page order. The human picks the keepers. Never uploads to a store, never shows a size, part, feature or result the product lacks. Not for ads with text, infographics or screenshots — make-static-ads; not for marketplace listing sets (not covered yet).
